bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
bot=deploy-gaybbs-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "$bot")" = running || exit 75
echo "LINK_INLINE_PREFLIGHT"
docker exec "$bot" node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs -e 'const fs=require("fs");const t=fs.readFileSync("/run/secrets/bot_token","utf8").trim();const c=new AbortController();setTimeout(()=>c.abort(),14000);fetch("https://api.telegram.org/bot"+t+"/getMe",{signal:c.signal}).then(r=>r.json()).then(x=>{console.log("GETME="+(x.ok?"PASS":"FAIL"));console.log("INLINE="+(x.result?.supports_inline_queries===true?"ENABLED":"DISABLED"))}).catch(()=>console.log("GETME=NETWORK_ERROR"))'
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT 'DB_LINK_CODE_COLUMNS='||COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='link_button_posts' AND column_name IN ('share_code','media_kind','media_file_id','caption_above');"
echo "LINK_INLINE_PREFLIGHT_END"
